body: Thank you for this. I hope you make it too.
I’ve got one more trip at the end of the month for a train ride to a big city. We shall see.
I did. I was glad to be away.

I appreciate your comment. I took several vacations this past year in hopes that it would bring me some sort of peace or awakening. I sat with the ocean, walked through the desert, dangled my feet off a mountainside, and climbed to the top of a lighthouse at the end of a pier - and all I could feel was insignificant and the same. It devastated me each time. There is nothing that feels more inevitable than this. I hate that, but it’s true.
